events.name: January Birthday Adoption Special
events.description:
Heather and Anna both have January birthdays and instead of gifts, we’re paying it forward to the dogs.
For the rest of January, adoption fees are WAIVED for our current adoptable pups with a qualifying donation!!!
Here’s why:
❄️ Cold weather is here!
🤰 We are taking in pregnant mamas who need safe, warm space!!
🐾 We need our current dogs out of the shelter and into homes so we can help the next ones!!
Your donation helps cover:
• Vet care
• Food
• Worming & shots
• Heat, bedding, and supplies for incoming moms and puppies
You get a dog.
A mama gets safety.
Puppies get a chance before they’re even born.
If you’ve been thinking about adopting this is your sign!!

events.name: Community Adoption Meet and Greet
events.description:
Come see us this weekend at our adoption event!!! Weve got tons of puppies needing homes!!!
Come adopt a pup!
Bring us some supplies,
Just come meet us and see what our work is doing!
Let's make this a community event!!! Come meet the people behind forgotten paws!!!
